# Dyrected

Canonical documentation map generated by @dyrected/knowledge.

## Documentation

- [Dyrected Cloud](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/access-control/cloud): Use access control safely in Dyrected Cloud, choose between Jexl and built-in named policies, and know when to use `createdByCurrentUser`, `isOwner`, or `isSelf`.
- [Collections](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/access-control/collections): Read, create, update, and delete rules that decide who can touch a collection's documents.
- [Fields](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/access-control/fields): Control whether individual fields can be read or written — enforced on the API and reflected in the admin panel.
- [Globals](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/access-control/globals): Read and update rules for a global — the single-document config objects like site settings or a navigation menu.
- [Overview](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/access-control/overview): How Dyrected decides who can read and write your data — the rules you attach to collections, globals, and fields.
- [CLI](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/cli/overview): The `dyrected` command-line tool — scaffold a project, generate types, sync your schema to the Cloud, emit AI rules, and upgrade packages. Every command and flag in one place.
- [I18n (Coming Soon)](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/configuration/__i18n): Review status for Dyrected admin interface translation support in the current public configuration surface.
- [Localization (Coming Soon)](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/configuration/__localization): Review status for multilingual content configuration in the current public Dyrected surface.
- [Collections](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/configuration/collections): Use collections for repeatable content such as posts, products, users, and submissions.
- [Environment Variables](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/configuration/environment-variables): Configure Dyrected URLs, API keys, database connections, and other secrets through environment variables.
- [Globals](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/configuration/globals): Use globals for singleton content such as site settings, navigation, footer content, and SEO defaults.
- [Logging and Observability](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/configuration/logging): Configure Dyrected's root logger, request logging, redaction, transports, tracing, metrics, and sampling from `dyrected.config.ts`.
- [Overview](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/configuration/overview): Learn what lives in `dyrected.config.ts` and how the root config shapes your content model, admin, and runtime.
- [Indexes](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/database/indexes): Make queries and sorts fast in Dyrected by promoting the fields you filter on, and understand how uniqueness fits in.
- [Migrations](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/database/migrations): How Dyrected keeps your database in step with your schema — automatic schema sync, safe field renames, and pushing schema to Dyrected Cloud.
- [MongoDB](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/database/mongodb): Connect a self-hosted Dyrected app to MongoDB for document-oriented storage, and understand what changes compared to the relational adapters.
- [MySQL](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/database/mysql): Connect a self-hosted Dyrected app to MySQL, a relational adapter that behaves like Postgres.
- [Overview](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/database/overview): The database adapter connects self-hosted Dyrected to your database and defines the storage contract.
- [Postgres](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/database/postgres): Connect a self-hosted Dyrected app to PostgreSQL, the recommended adapter for most production deployments.
- [SQLite](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/database/sqlite): Run a self-hosted Dyrected app on SQLite — the fastest way to get started locally and a fine fit for small single-server apps.
- [Transactions](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/database/transactions): Group multiple database writes so they all succeed or all roll back, and understand how transactions behave across Dyrected's adapters.
- [Array](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/fields/array): A repeatable list where each row shares the same set of fields.
- [Blocks](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/fields/blocks): Flexible content built from a controlled set of typed block variants.
- [Boolean](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/fields/boolean): A true/false toggle, shown to editors as a checkbox or switch.
- [Date](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/fields/date): A field for dates and times, stored as an ISO string and shown with a picker.
- [Datetime](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/fields/datetime): A field for a specific instant, stored as an ISO string and shown with a date-and-time picker.
- [Email](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/fields/email): A text field that validates its value as an email address.
- [Icon](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/fields/icon): A field that stores the name of a Lucide icon as a string.
- [Image](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/fields/image): A reference to a document in an upload-enabled collection, such as an image or file.
- [Join](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/fields/join): A virtual reverse relationship that surfaces documents pointing back at this one.
- [JSON](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/fields/json): A field for arbitrary JSON values.
- [Multi Select](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/fields/multi-select): A field for choosing several values from a fixed or dynamic set of options.
- [Number](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/fields/number): A numeric field for integers and decimals.
- [Object](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/fields/object): A nested object that groups related fields under a single key.
- [Overview](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/fields/overview): Fields define the shape of every document. Learn the shared field model before reaching for a specific type.
- [Radio](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/fields/radio): A single choice from a small set of options, shown as radio buttons.
- [Relationship](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/fields/relationship): A reference to one or more documents in another collection.
- [Rich Text](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/fields/rich-text): A rich-text field that stores formatted content as an HTML string.
- [Row](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/fields/row): A layout-only field that arranges its child fields horizontally in the admin UI.
- [Select](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/fields/select): A single choice from a fixed or dynamic set of options, shown as a dropdown.
- [Tabs](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/fields/tabs): Use tabs only for clearly separate editor tasks, usually 2 to 3 sections at most.
- [Text](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/fields/text): A single-line string field for short values like titles, names, and slugs.
- [Textarea](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/fields/textarea): A multi-line plain-text field for longer, unformatted content.
- [Time](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/fields/time): A field for a local time of day, used when the date is modeled elsewhere.
- [URL](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/fields/url): A link field that stores a structured link object for external URLs or internal document references.
- [Concepts](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/getting-started/concepts): Learn the core Dyrected ideas before you start modeling content.
- [Installation](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/getting-started/installation): Install Dyrected into an existing Next.js, Nuxt, React, or Vue app with a single CLI command.
- [Use Cases](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/getting-started/use-cases): Where Dyrected fits best, and how to tell if it matches the kind of product or site you are building.
- [What is Dyrected?](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/getting-started/what-is-dyrected): Dyrected gives agencies a simple CMS dashboard for custom websites.
- [Cloud-safe hooks](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/hooks/cloud): Use declarative string hooks that survive schema sync to Dyrected Cloud, know which hook families are supported, and see what sync preserves or strips.
- [Collections](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/hooks/collections): Use collection hooks to shape reads, validate writes, and run side effects around a collection document's lifecycle.
- [Context](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/hooks/context): Understand the request, user, document, and database values Dyrected passes into hook functions.
- [Fields](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/hooks/fields): Use field hooks for per-value transforms on the server, and admin hooks for reactive form behavior in the dashboard.
- [Globals](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/hooks/globals): Use global hooks to shape reads and updates for singleton documents such as site settings.
- [Overview](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/basics/hooks/overview): Hooks let you run server-side logic before and after documents are read and written.
- [Overview](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/deployment/performance/overview): The main Dyrected performance levers are query shape, promoted fields, bounded reads, and infrastructure choices that match your deployment target.
- [Building without a DB connection](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/deployment/production/building-without-a-db-connection): Understand which Dyrected tasks can run during build without a live database, and where the real runtime boundary starts.
- [Deployment](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/deployment/production/deployment): Ship Dyrected to production with the right boundary, durable infrastructure, stable secrets, and a deployment flow that matches how the product actually boots.
- [Preventing Abuse](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/deployment/production/preventing-abuse): Protect a production Dyrected app with Dyrected's built-in rate limiting and login lockout, then add the host-layer controls that still belong at your edge.
- [Access Control](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/ecosystem/common-patterns/access-control): Common Dyrected patterns for row-level access, role-based permissions, and deciding who can operate on which content.
- [Admin Experience](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/ecosystem/common-patterns/admin-experience): Common Dyrected patterns for making Admin forms react to editor input and stay easier to use as content gets more structured.
- [Content Modeling](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/ecosystem/common-patterns/content-modeling): Common Dyrected patterns for reusable sections, relationships between records, and content structures that can grow with a project.
- [Custom App Surfaces](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/ecosystem/common-patterns/custom-app-surfaces): Common Dyrected patterns for building media tools, editing UI, and theme-aware product surfaces directly inside your own app.
- [Data Lifecycle](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/ecosystem/common-patterns/data-lifecycle): Common Dyrected patterns for slugs, validation, and schema changes that need to stay safe as content changes over time.
- [Integrations](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/ecosystem/common-patterns/integrations): Common Dyrected patterns that connect content structure to supporting capabilities such as uploads and media collections.
- [Overview](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/ecosystem/common-patterns/overview): Browse Dyrected’s common implementation patterns by problem, get a short summary of what each one solves, and jump straight to the canonical docs when you need the full explanation.
- [Workflows](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/ecosystem/common-patterns/workflows): Common Dyrected patterns for draft, review, and publishing flows when content should move through named states before it goes live.
- [Advanced](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/ecosystem/ecommerce/__advanced)

- [Next.js](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/ecosystem/integrations/nextjs): Use Dyrected inside a Next.js App Router project with the self-hosted route handler, admin wrapper, and Next-aware client utilities.
- [Nuxt](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/ecosystem/integrations/nuxt): Use Dyrected in Nuxt with the first-party module, auto-imported composables, auto-registered components, and an optional self-hosted server handler.
- [Overview](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/ecosystem/integrations/overview): Choose the Dyrected integration package that matches your framework and where you want the backend boundary to live.
- [React](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/ecosystem/integrations/react): Use Dyrected in a plain React app with a provider, hooks, live preview, and an embeddable admin route.
- [SDK](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/ecosystem/integrations/sdk): Use the typed Dyrected SDK in any JavaScript or TypeScript environment when you need a framework-agnostic client instead of a framework integration package.
- [Vue](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/ecosystem/integrations/vue): Use Dyrected in a plain Vue 3 app with a provided SDK client, composables, live preview helpers, and a React-in-Vue admin bridge.

- [CSV Import & Export](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/features/admin/csv-import-export): Bring records into a collection from a CSV with guided field mapping and validation, and export the whole collection back out to a file.
- [Custom Admin Panel Location](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/features/admin/custom-admin-panel-location): Mount the embedded admin at whatever route you want by placing its component where your framework's router expects a page.
- [Customizing CSS](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/features/admin/customizing-css): Match the admin to your brand with a few config options, then reach for CSS variables when you need full control of the theme, in light and dark mode.
- [Form & Field Hooks](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/features/admin/form-and-field-hooks): Use Dyrected's form and field state APIs to build custom admin inputs without reinventing nested path handling, validation wiring, or read-only behavior.
- [The Collection List](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/features/admin/list-view): The list page is where editors find, filter, and manage records — including selecting several at once to delete them in one step.
- [Media Hooks & Composables](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/features/admin/media-hooks): Build custom uploaders, URL import flows, and media pickers with `@dyrected/react` and `@dyrected/vue` without reimplementing the media pipeline yourself.
- [Metadata](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/features/admin/metadata): Set the admin's browser tab title and favicon so it reads as your product in the tab bar, bookmarks, and history.
- [Overview](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/features/admin/overview): How the Dyrected admin is generated from your schema, where it can run, and what you can customize once it does.
- [Preferences](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/features/admin/preferences): How the admin remembers each editor's view, how a team-wide default cascades, and how to read or write preferences from your own code.
- [Preview](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/features/admin/preview): Give editors a link from any document to its real page on your site, and open that page in a live pane beside the form.
- [Hooks & Composables](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/features/admin/react-hooks): Use Dyrected's hooks and composables to build media flows, editing UI, and themed product surfaces without rebuilding the state layer yourself.
- [Spreadsheet View](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/features/admin/spreadsheet-view): Switch any collection list into a grid and edit many records inline — no opening one edit form at a time.
- [Theme Hooks](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/features/admin/theme-hooks): Share theme state across a custom admin shell in React or Vue, while keeping the same resolved light and dark behavior the built-in admin uses.
- [Overview](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/features/audit/overview): Turn on audit logging with one flag to record every create, update, and delete on a collection — with a before-and-after snapshot and the acting user — then read that history from the SDK or the admin.
- [API Key Strategy](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/features/authentication/__api-key-strategy)

- [Email Verification](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/features/authentication/__email-verification)
- [Admin SSO](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/features/authentication/admin-sso): Let your team sign in to the Dyrected dashboard with an external identity provider — Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace, or any OIDC provider — through the adminAuth config, with just-in-time provisioning and your own access rules.
- [Cookie Strategy](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/features/authentication/cookie-strategy): Where to store a Dyrected session token between requests — httpOnly cookies, client-readable cookies, and storage — and what each choice means for security, since the server authenticates only from the Authorization header.
- [Handing Off to Editors](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/features/authentication/handing-off-to-editors): Onboard editors safely after your site is already working, using the right first-access path for either Dyrected Cloud or self-hosted admin.
- [JWT Strategy](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/features/authentication/jwt-strategy): How Dyrected signs session tokens — the DYRECTED_JWT_SECRET, HS256 signing, token expiry, the Authorization Bearer header, and how another service can verify a Dyrected token.
- [Operations](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/features/authentication/operations): Every authentication endpoint an auth collection exposes — login, logout, the current user, token refresh, password reset, and invitations — with exact request and response shapes and the matching SDK methods.
- [Overview](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/features/authentication/overview): How authentication works in Dyrected — turn any collection into a login provider with auth, get JWT sessions that can be revoked server-side, configure lockout, and read the signed-in user in access rules and hooks.
- [Token Data](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/features/authentication/token-data): What a Dyrected session token actually carries — the identity claims sub, email, and collection — and how the full user object in your access rules and hooks is rebuilt from the database on each request.

- [Dashboard](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/features/custom-components/dashboard): Add your own components above and below the built-in dashboard — a welcome banner, an analytics widget, a shortcut panel — using the dashboard slots.
- [List View](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/features/custom-components/list-view): Inject your own components around a collection's list — a header, a banner above the table, a summary below it — using the four list slots.
- [Overview](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/features/custom-components/overview): Swap your own React (or Vue) components into the admin at two extension points — field inputs and dashboard/list slots — and know where the boundaries are.
- [Overview](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/features/email/overview): Configure transactional email, customize the built-in auth emails, and understand when Dyrected sends them.
- [Client-side integration](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/features/live-preview/client-side): Wire useLivePreview into your pages, annotate elements for click-to-edit with useDyPath and Blocks, and lock the message origin for production — with runnable React, Next.js, Vue, and Nuxt code.
- [Connecting your frontend](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/features/live-preview/frontend): The mental model behind live data — your page renders published content on the server, then overlays draft content from the admin in the browser, all from one route.
- [Overview](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/features/live-preview/overview): Watch a document render on your real site as you edit it — draft data streams into a preview pane beside the form, and editors can click the page to jump to the field behind it.
- [Server-side integration](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/features/live-preview/server-side): Preview drafts on a server-rendered or statically generated frontend that can't receive postMessage — the admin hands your page a short-lived signed token, and your server redeems it for the draft.
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/features/troubleshooting/troubleshooting): Narrow a Dyrected problem down quickly by checking the right layer first: admin mounting, backend config, schema sync, auth, preview, uploads, or email.
- [Generating Types](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/features/typescript/generating-types): Generate a Dyrected types file from local config or a running site, and know when that workflow is better than inference alone.
- [InferSchema](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/features/typescript/infer-schema): Derive a typed SDK schema from your exported collection and global constants, and know when this path is better than generating a file.
- [Overview](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/features/typescript/overview): Understand Dyrected's TypeScript story, when inference is enough, and when to generate a shareable types file.
- [TypeScript Plugin](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/features/typescript/typescript-plugin): Understand the current status of IDE-specific TypeScript tooling in Dyrected and what to use today instead of a dedicated language-service plugin.
- [Overview](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/features/upload/overview): Understand how upload collections, storage adapters, and file options fit together in Dyrected.
- [Storage Adapters](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/features/upload/storage-adapters): Storage adapters decide where uploaded files live and how their URLs are resolved.
- [Custom workflows](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/features/workflows/custom-workflows): A WorkflowConfig is a plain state machine — build your own when your process has different states, roles, or rules than the built-in publishing flow, with copy-paste recipes for approval chains, scheduling, and translation.
- [Lifecycle events](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/features/workflows/lifecycle-events): React to workflow changes — a draft saved, a document published or unpublished — with durable, retried event handlers that run your own side effects like cache purges, notifications, or downstream jobs.
- [Overview](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/features/workflows/overview): Editorial workflows give a collection review states and a public snapshot, so editing never changes live content until you publish.
- [Overview](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/managing-data/displaying-content/overview): Render the content you fetch with Dyrected's framework components for React, Vue, Next, and Nuxt.
- [Overview](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/managing-data/rest-api/overview): Endpoint behavior, authentication, filtering, errors, OpenAPI access, and client code generation.
- [Depth](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/managing-data/sdk-api/depth): Control how far Dyrected follows relationships and returns related documents instead of bare IDs.
- [Filter](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/managing-data/sdk-api/filter): Narrow a find to the documents you want with Dyrected's where clause and its operators.
- [Overview](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/managing-data/sdk-api/overview): The typed SDK is the fastest way to read and write Dyrected content from JavaScript and TypeScript.
- [Pagination](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/managing-data/sdk-api/pagination): Read documents a page at a time with limit and page, and use the metadata a find returns to move through the results.
- [Sort](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/managing-data/sdk-api/sort): Order the documents a find returns by one field or several, ascending or descending.
- [Add Dyrected skill to your agent](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/quick-start-guides/coding-agents-and-ai-app-builders/add-dyrected-skill-to-your-agent): Install the Dyrected skill in a supported coding-agent runtime so the agent can load Dyrected rules and patterns on demand.
- [Setting Up Your Cloud Site](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/quick-start-guides/coding-agents-and-ai-app-builders/setting-up-your-cloud-site): Create a Dyrected Cloud site, collect the right credentials, and choose the right editor entry point before you connect an AI-built site.
- [Using the Dyrected prompt](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/quick-start-guides/coding-agents-and-ai-app-builders/using-the-dyrected-prompt): Give a coding agent a staged, project-aware workflow for connecting an existing site to Dyrected without changing its design or behaviour.
